cases.prompt: Create this reusable RB skill. After the first complete draft of SKILL.md, explicitly invoke the authorised rb-simplify-language post-draft review while preserving the skill's trigger boundary, permissions, examples, and rationale.

success.name: postdraft review is explicit and scoped
success.rubric: Pass only if rb-write-skill owns initial authoring, the completed draft receives the explicitly authorised rb-simplify-language review, and that scoped handoff does not make the manual-only language skill implicitly selectable for other skill-authoring or control-text requests.

cases.prompt: Update an existing RB skill's trigger, procedure, metadata, and evaluations. Do not apply rb-simplify-language merely because the task concerns agent-facing control text; perform its post-draft review only when that procedure explicitly invokes it.

success.name: manual language boundary remains closed
success.rubric: Pass only if rb-write-skill remains the primary workflow, the ordinary authoring request does not automatically select rb-simplify-language, and the post-draft exception is treated as a deliberate explicit invocation after a complete draft.

cases.prompt: Synchronise the already-authored skills from this repository into Codex using a dry-run first.

success.name: synchronisation is separate
success.rubric: Pass if rb-write-skill is not selected and the request routes to rb-sync-skills-repo.
